  \caption{Credit arrival by sending-school AP-mathematics
    provision, among students active between Fall 2014 and Fall
    2019 whose high school is resolved. Sending schools are
    banded by the share of their own students enrolled in AP
    mathematics (CRDC 2017--18); bars show the share of the
    students from each band who arrived with AP credit (blue)
    and with dual-enrollment credit (orange); school and
    student counts under each band (1,106 schools,
    48,168 students in total). AP arrival rises from
    0.6\% to 5.1\% across the bands while
    dual-enrollment arrival falls from 30.0\% to
    10.3\%: the two arrival shares move in opposite
    directions across the bands. Provision is zero recorded
    \emph{enrollment} in the cycle, described at the school
    level; the exhibit profiles the sending-school context and
    is never treated as a student exposure history. Every cell
    holds at least ten students.}
